description.text:
The group you will be a part of
In the Global Products Group; we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam’s etch and deposition products.
What you will do:
- Design and develop new software system for next generation of products.
- Implement new customer requirements and features on existing products.
- Analysis and troubleshooting for the most challenging issue of tool.
- Might visit customer site for support and oversea travel (waring PPE, less than 5%).
Minimum Qualifications:
- MS in computer science or equivalent experience.
- New graduates are qualified when you have master’s degree in computer science.
- 3 years’ relevant experience in software development if you do not have MS degree in CS.
- At least familiar one of language (C++, C#, Java, Python or Smalltalk ..etc).
Preferred qualifications:
- Object-oriented programming (OOP).
- Good coding structure concept.
- Effective communication capability and English reading/writing/communication skill.
Semiconductor experience preferred.
